meta.title: A Company Can Report Record Profits And The Stock Still Crashes
meta.hook: A company can beat last year's profit and still watch its stock fall because the market was expecting even more.
meta.description: Stock prices react to results versus expectations, not results alone — expectations are already baked into a stock's price before news is officially announced, a phenomenon known as 'priced in.' That's why genuinely good results can still send a stock down, and why 'bad' news can sometimes send it up. Educational content only, not financial advice.
